title: Internal docs: add Unit Economics dashboard hub + link runbooks/definitions
author: Allison Grant
description: This PR updates the internal docs site to include a single “Unit Economics Dashboard” hub page and fixes/standardizes links to the canonical Confluence sources for definitions, SLOs, and oncall procedures. The goal is to reduce ping-pong across Slack threads and PR descriptions by having one stable entry point that Finance/Product/Eng can bookmark. The hub also documents access control expectations (feature flag + RBAC) and explicitly calls out v1 limitations so the metric isn’t over-interpreted. Changes include: (1) new internal docs page that links to the PRD, UX spec, metric dictionary, ADR for cost attribution, and Finance methodology note; (2) links to the SLO page and the oncall runbook (investigation + backfill) plus a short “how to validate freshness/completeness” checklist; (3) updated navigation entry under Observability → Cost & Usage; (4) replaced stale/notionally-correct but broken URLs referenced from older dashboard docs; (5) added a short section on data quality/confidence indicators and what to do when the dashboard disagrees with billing (points to reconciliation report/runbook). No product behavior changes; docs-only.
commits: docs(internal): add unit economics dashboard hub page

release_notes: Internal docs now include a Unit Economics Dashboard hub page with canonical links to definitions, SLOs, runbooks, and reconciliation guidance.
Navigation updated under Observability → Cost & Usage; stale/broken links cleaned up.
